title: 杰斯·高塔晨光
description: 杰斯穿完整蓝白科技衣甲，站在高塔平台静扶落地的海克斯锤，城市天际与强烈窗光衬出英气轮廓。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Jayce is a strong adult Piltover inventor with neat dark brown hair, a clean-shaven square face, and a composed confident expression. Preserve his blue-white and gold technological costume with a fully covering fitted jacket, opaque trousers, gauntlets, and boots. His large transforming hextech hammer rests head-down on the floor, held calmly by the handle with its core inactive and no cannon configuration.
art_direction.scene: Place him on a broad tower platform beside an enormous open window, one hand resting on the grounded hammer and the other near his belt. A clean city skyline recedes far below the safe parapet. Strong morning light separates gold edges and blue armor planes through decisive wax-crayon strokes, with minimal architecture and no machinery moving or firing.
art_direction.palette: cobalt, ivory, pale brass, steel-blue shadow
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
